title: alchemilla alpina subsp. pallens
intro: Alchemilla alpina subsp. pallens, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla alpina subsp. pallens include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it useful in treating skin issues, wounds, and minor injuries. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
